claim: The canonical monorepo carries no repository-local GitHub-recognized SECURITY.md and retained owner policies still route private vulnerability reports to pre-monorepo standalone repositories.
nonClaims: No claim is made that the GitHub organization lacks an organization-wide default community health SECURITY.md; provider-level fallback was not read back in this falsifier.
Nested owner SECURITY.md files remain useful owner documentation but are not the canonical repository community-health policy location.
acceptance: Add a canonical monorepo SECURITY.md in a GitHub-recognized repository location or explicitly bind and verify an organization-level policy.
Route private vulnerability reporting to the canonical provider repository/authority.
Retain owner-specific security boundaries as subordinate documentation without stale standalone reporting links.
Add repository-governance verification for the reporting authority and recognized policy location.
